This notebook applies eigenMT as a fast proxy for permutation-based
multiple-testing correction of the per-stratum MatrixEQTL results. We first
reformat the MatrixEQTL outputs into the column layout eigenMT expects, run
eigenMT per chromosome (see `04-run_eigenmt.sh`), combine the per-chromosome
results into a single merged table, assemble the full combined cis-eQTL summary
statistics with GRCh37/38 annotation, and compute eigenMT-corrected
significance (p-value times the eigenMT effective number of tests) at the
published critical COVID-19 GWAS loci.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(qs2)
```

```{r paths-and-parameters}
# ---- EDIT THESE PATHS FOR YOUR ENVIRONMENT --------------------------------
# base_dir            : root for all inputs and outputs of this track.
# results_dir         : holds final_files/, results/, eigenMT_FDR/, etc.
# data_env_path       : IMPACC acute-phase data environment (RDS) for gene
#                       row features.
# genotype_bim_path   : .bim of the full post-QC IMPACC genotype set, used to
#                       map GRCh37 IDs to GRCh38 and recover minor/major alleles.
# published_snps_path : Excel workbook of published critical COVID-19 GWAS hits.
# chr12_ld_path       : LDlink output for the chr12:112922758 proxy search.
base_dir            <- path.expand("/path/to/eqtl_data")
results_dir         <- file.path(base_dir, "tg_eQTL_with_convalescent")
data_env_path       <- file.path(base_dir, "expression_data",
                                 "impacc_full-cohort_acute_data_env_030625.RDS")
genotype_bim_path   <- file.path(base_dir, "genotype_data",
                                 "impacc_chrALL_imputed_rsq07_ancestry_maf05_38.bim")
published_snps_path <- file.path(base_dir, "tg_impacc_GWAS",
                                 "All_Severe_COVID_GWAS_hits.xlsx")
chr12_ld_path       <- file.path(base_dir, "chr12_LD_proxy", "chr12_112922758_LD.txt")
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

final_files_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "final_files")
matrix_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "results")
formatted_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "eigenMT_FDR", "eigenMT_formatted_files")
eigenmt_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "eigenMT_FDR", "eigenMT_results")
combined_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "eigenMT_FDR", "eigenMT_combined_final_result")
sumstats_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "tg_sumstats")
for (d in c(combined_dir, sumstats_dir)) if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)

visits <- paste0("visit_", 1:10)
groups <- c("case", "control")
```

## Reformat MatrixEQTL output for eigenMT

eigenMT needs the chromosome prefix stripped and the QTL columns renamed
(SNP, t-stat, p-value) with beta placed before the statistic. We rewrite the
SNP, snploc, geneloc, and cis-eQTL files into an `eigenMT_formatted_files`
directory per stratum.

```{r}
# 19 unique chromosomes present: 1 10 11 12 13 16 17 19 2 20 21 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 X

# Loop over visits and groups
for (visit in visits) {
  for (group in groups) {

    # Skip visit_5 control only
    if(visit == "visit_5" && group == "control") {
      message("Skipping ", visit, " ", group)
      next
    }
    message("Processing ", visit, " ", group, " ...")

    # Create output directory for formatted files
    out_dir <- file.path(formatted_dir, visit, group)
    if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
      dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    }

    ## Process snploc file
    snploc_in <- file.path(final_files_dir, visit, group, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_snploc.txt"))
    snploc_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_snploc_eigenMT.txt"))

    dt_snploc <- fread(snploc_in) %>%
      # Remove the "chr" prefix from the chr column
      mutate(chr = gsub("chr", "", chr))

    fwrite(dt_snploc, snploc_out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

    ## Process SNP file
    snp_in <- file.path(final_files_dir, visit, group, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_SNP.txt"))
    snp_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_SNP_eigenMT.txt"))

    dt_snp <- fread(snp_in)

    fwrite(dt_snp, snp_out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

    ## Process cis_eQTL file (from the 'results' directory)
    qtl_in <- file.path(matrix_results_dir, visit, group, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_cis_eQTL.txt"))
    qtl_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_cis_eQTL_eigenMT.txt"))

    dt_qtl <- fread(qtl_in) %>%
      # Move the beta column to come before statistic
      relocate(beta, .before = statistic) %>%
      # Rename columns as needed for eigenMT
      rename(SNP = snps,
             `t-stat` = statistic,
             `p-value` = pvalue)

    fwrite(dt_qtl, qtl_out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

    ## Process geneloc file
    geneloc_in <- file.path(final_files_dir, visit, group, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_geneloc.txt"))
    geneloc_out <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(visit, "_", group, "_geneloc_eigenMT.txt"))

    dt_geneloc <- fread(geneloc_in) %>%
      # Remove the "chr" prefix from the chr column
      mutate(chr = gsub("chr", "", chr))

    fwrite(dt_geneloc, geneloc_out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

    message("Finished processing ", visit, " ", group)
  }
}
```

Run eigenMT now: the per-chromosome eigenMT runs are performed by
`04-run_eigenmt.sh`, which reads the eigenMT-formatted files written above,
splits each stratum by chromosome, calls `eigenMT.py`, and writes one output
file per chromosome per stratum.

## Combine the per-chromosome eigenMT results

For each stratum we row-bind the per-chromosome eigenMT outputs into one merged
table, then row-bind all strata into the final combined eigenMT result.

```{r}
# Create an empty list to store merged data for each visit/group.
final_list <- list()

# Loop over each visit and group
for (visit in visits) {
  for (grp in groups) {

    # Skip visit_5 control only
    if(visit == "visit_5" && grp == "control") {
      message("Skipping ", visit, " ", grp)
      next
    }

    message("Processing ", visit, " ", grp, " ...")

    # Define the directory for the current visit and group.
    input_dir <- file.path(eigenmt_results_dir, visit, grp)
    if (!dir.exists(input_dir)) {
      message("Directory ", input_dir, " does not exist; skipping.")
      next
    }

    # Construct a regex pattern to match all chromosome-specific eigenMT files for this visit/group.
    # For example: "^chr.*_visit_1_case_eigenMT.txt$"
    pattern <- paste0("^chr.*_", visit, "_", grp, "_eigenMT\\.txt$")
    files <- list.files(path = input_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)

    if (length(files) == 0) {
      message("No eigenMT files found for ", visit, " ", grp, "; skipping.")
      next
    }

    # Read the header from the first file to establish column names.
    header <- names(fread(files[1], nrows = 0))

    # Read each file, checking that the header is consistent.
    dfs <- lapply(files, function(file) {
      dt <- fread(file)
      if (!identical(names(dt), header)) {
        stop(sprintf("Header mismatch in file: %s", file))
      }
      return(dt)
    })

    # Merge all files row-wise.
    merged_data <- rbindlist(dfs)

    # Add the visit and group columns.
    merged_data <- merged_data %>% mutate(visit = visit, group = grp)

    # Define output file name for the merged data.
    output_file <- file.path(input_dir, paste0(visit, "_", grp, "_merged_eigenMT.txt"))

    # Write the merged data to the output file.
    fwrite(merged_data, file = output_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

    message("Merged eigenMT results for ", visit, " ", grp, " saved to ", output_file)

    # Store the merged data for the final combined merge.
    final_list[[paste0(visit, "_", grp)]] <- merged_data
  }
}

# Combine all merged data across visits and groups.
if (length(final_list) > 0) {
  combined_data <- rbindlist(final_list)
  combined_output_file <- file.path(combined_dir, "final_all_merged_eigenMT.txt")
  fwrite(combined_data, file = combined_output_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
  message("Final combined eigenMT results saved to ", combined_output_file)
} else {
  message("No merged eigenMT files were generated.")
}

# final file is stored in: file.path(combined_dir, "final_all_merged_eigenMT.txt")
```

## Assemble the combined cis-eQTL summary statistics

We read all per-stratum MatrixEQTL results, tag each with its visit and group,
annotate with gene names and the GRCh37-to-GRCh38 mapping (and minor/major
alleles) from the genotype .bim, and save the combined summary statistics.

```{r}
# Initialize an empty list to hold each cis-eQTL results data frame.
all_eqtls <- list()

# Get the list of visit directories (e.g., "visit_1", "visit_2", ..., "visit_10")
visit_dirs <- list.dirs(matrix_results_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Loop through each visit directory.
for (visit_dir in visit_dirs) {
  visit_name <- basename(visit_dir)  # e.g., "visit_1"

  # Get the list of group directories (should be "case" and "control") within the visit directory.
  group_dirs <- list.dirs(visit_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

  # Loop through each group directory.
  for (group_dir in group_dirs) {
    group_name <- basename(group_dir)  # "case" or "control"

    # Construct the file name assuming it follows the naming convention:
    # e.g., "visit_1_case_cis_eQTL.txt"
    eqtl_file <- file.path(group_dir, paste0(visit_name, "_", group_name, "_cis_eQTL.txt"))

    # Check if the file exists; if not, skip this group.
    if (!file.exists(eqtl_file)) {
      message("File does not exist: ", eqtl_file)
      next
    }

    # Read the cis-eQTL results file.
    df <- fread(eqtl_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    # Add two new columns:
    #   - "visit": to record the visit (e.g., "visit_1")
    #   - "group": to record the case/control designation.
    df$visit <- visit_name
    df$group <- group_name

    # Append this data frame to the list.
    all_eqtls[[length(all_eqtls) + 1]] <- df
  }
}

# Combine all the data frames into one giant data frame.
combined_eqtls <- bind_rows(all_eqtls)

data_env <- readRDS(data_env_path)

rowfeature <- data_env$pbmc_transcriptomics_rowfeature %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
        select(gene, gene_name)

grch38_to_37 <- fread(genotype_bim_path) %>%
    select(-"V3") %>%
    rename(grch37 = "V2",
           minor = "V5",
           major = "V6") %>%
           unite(`grch38`, c("V1","V4"), sep = ":")

# Reorder columns so that "visit" and "group" appear first.
combined_eqtls_final <- combined_eqtls %>%
  select(visit, group, snps, gene, statistic, pvalue, FDR, beta) %>%
  rename(grch37 = snps) %>%
  inner_join(rowfeature, by = "gene") %>%
  relocate(gene_name, .before = "statistic") %>%
  inner_join(grch38_to_37, by = "grch37") %>%
  relocate(grch38, .before = "gene")

# Save the combined cis-eQTL results.
qs_save(combined_eqtls_final, file.path(sumstats_dir, "combined_eqtls_tg_final.qs2"))

### LOAD HERE
# combined_eqtls_tg_final <- qs_read(file.path(sumstats_dir, "combined_eqtls_tg_final.qs2"))
```

## eigenMT-corrected significance at the published GWAS loci

We restrict to the published critical COVID-19 GWAS SNPs (plus a chosen chr12
LD proxy), join the eigenMT effective test counts, and compute the
eigenMT-corrected significance as p-value times TESTS. eigenMT < 0.01 is the
chosen significance filter for these loci.

```{r}
published_snps <- read_excel(published_snps_path) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(),
              values_to = "grch38") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`grch38`)) %>%
  group_by(grch38) %>%
  mutate(source = if(n() > 1) "both" else as.character(name)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-"name") %>%
  distinct(grch38, source)

missing_snps <- fread(file.path(base_dir, "genotype_data", "twelve_SNPs_not_in_IMPACC_cohort.txt"), header = F) %>%
    rename("grch38" = "V1")

# Accounting of the 69 published variants:
# 57 variants are present in our data; 13 of those have FDR eQTLs <= 1e-6 at
# some visit and cohort. Of the 12 missing variants, 9 had MAF < 0.05, 1 is on
# the X chromosome, and 2 are on chr12 (chr12:112922758 and chr12:112919637) in
# r2 = 0.9668 LD, for which we select an LD proxy below. 57 + 9 + 1 + 2 = 69.

# Choose an LD proxy for the two correlated chr12 reported SNPs.
chr12_ld_proxies <- fread(chr12_ld_path) %>%
    select(Coord, R2, Correlated_Alleles) %>%
    mutate(Coord = gsub("chr", "", Coord)) %>%
    rename(grch38 = Coord) %>%
    filter(R2 > 0.59) %>%
    inner_join(combined_eqtls_final, by = "grch38") %>%
    filter(FDR <= 10^-6)

# Chosen proxy: 12:112945172
# r2 = 0.6259 with chr12:112922758 and r2 = 0.6039 with chr12:112919637.
# eQTL FDR = 5.532148e-08 at visit_1 control. All 69 variants are accounted for.

# eigenMT effective test counts per gene/stratum.
eigenMT_final <- fread(file.path(combined_dir, "final_all_merged_eigenMT.txt")) %>%
  select(gene, TESTS, visit, group)

# Restrict to the published SNPs plus the chr12 proxy, join eigenMT TESTS, and
# compute eigenMT-corrected significance.
dynamic_eQTLs_snps <- published_snps %>%
    distinct(grch38) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(grch38 = "12:112945172")) %>%  # add the extra chr 12 proxy variant
    inner_join(combined_eqtls_final, by = "grch38") %>%
    inner_join(eigenMT_final, by = c("gene", "visit", "group")) %>%
    mutate(eigenMT = pvalue*TESTS) %>%
    relocate(eigenMT, .before="FDR") %>%
    rename(eigenMT_tests = "TESTS")

# eigenMT < 0.01 is the chosen filter for these loci (195 SNP-gene-stratum
# observations across the published loci pass).
eigenMT_filter <- dynamic_eQTLs_snps %>% filter(eigenMT < 0.01)
```

## Significant eQTLs and residuals for the plotting and downstream steps

These final steps identify the significant cis-eQTLs at the published GWAS loci,
compute covariate-adjusted residual expression for the Figure 4 plots, and save
the master object signif_eqtls_final_tg.qs2 that the colocalization notebook (05)
and the figure notebooks (07, 08) consume.

```{r paths-for-significant-eqtl-step}
# Additional paths used by the steps below.
final_dir     <- final_files_dir
residuals_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "dynamic_eQTL_analysis", "residuals")
if (!dir.exists(residuals_dir)) dir.create(residuals_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# combined_eqtls_tg_final was assembled and saved just above; reuse it here.
combined_eqtls_tg_final <- combined_eqtls_final
```

## Identify differential eQTLs across severity groups

We count, per SNP-gene pair and severity group, how many strata reach
eigenMT < 0.01, pivot to compare case (TG4-5) versus control (TG1-3), and retain
the pairs at the published loci with at least 10 visit-level tests and at least
one significant cis-eQTL. This is the differential-eQTL summary.

```{r}
# Load published SNP data and reformat
published_snps <- read_excel(published_snps_path) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), values_to = "grch38") %>%
  filter(!is.na(grch38)) %>%
  group_by(grch38) %>%
  mutate(source = if(n() > 1) "both" else as.character(name)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-name) %>%
  distinct(grch38, source)

# Create list of SNPs of interest and add extra proxy variant for chr12
published_snps_plus_chr12 <- published_snps %>%
  distinct(grch38) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(grch38 = "12:112945172"))

eigenMT_final <- fread(file.path(combined_dir, "final_all_merged_eigenMT.txt")) %>%
  select(gene, TESTS, visit, group)

# Convert to data.table
combined_eqtls_dt <- as.data.table(combined_eqtls_tg_final)
eigenMT_dt <- as.data.table(eigenMT_final)
published_snps_dt <- as.data.table(published_snps_plus_chr12)

# Set keys for faster joins
setkey(combined_eqtls_dt, gene, visit, group)
setkey(eigenMT_dt, gene, visit, group)

# Step 1: Join and summarize
group_summary_dt <- combined_eqtls_dt[eigenMT_dt, nomatch=0
  ][, eigenMT := pvalue*TESTS
  ][, .(total = .N,
        sig_count = sum(eigenMT < 0.01)),
    by = .(grch37, grch38, gene_name, gene, group)]

# Step 2: Pivot wider efficiently
summary_wide_dt <- dcast(group_summary_dt,
                        grch37 + grch38 + gene_name + gene ~ group,
                        value.var = c("total", "sig_count"),
                        fill = 0)

# Step 3: Final filtering
setkey(summary_wide_dt, grch38)
setkey(published_snps_dt, grch38)

result_dt <- summary_wide_dt[published_snps_dt, nomatch=0
  ][, total_all := total_case + total_control
  ][, sig_all := sig_count_case + sig_count_control
  ][total_all >= 10 & sig_all >= 1]

all_sig_eqtls <- result_dt %>%
  select(grch37, grch38, gene_name, gene)

all_sig_eqtls_sumstats <- combined_eqtls_tg_final %>%
  semi_join(all_sig_eqtls, by = c("grch37","grch38", "gene_name", "gene"))
# 91 significant eQTLs with a minimum of 10 visit-level tests and 1 cis-eQTL:
# 41 unique SNPs, 73 unique genes, 91 unique pairs.

qs_save(all_sig_eqtls_sumstats, file.path(sumstats_dir, "all_sig_eqtls_sumstats_pivot.qs2"))
```

## Compute covariate-adjusted residual expression for the significant pairs

For each significant SNP-gene pair and each stratum (visits 1-4, 6-10), we
regress inverse-normalized expression on the covariates (genotype excluded) and
keep the residuals together with the additive genotype dosage. These residuals
are what the Figure 4 boxplots and dose-response curves display.

```{r}
all_sig_eqtls_full_df <- all_sig_eqtls_sumstats %>%
  inner_join(eigenMT_final, by = c("gene", "visit", "group")) %>%
  mutate(eigenMT = pvalue*TESTS) %>%
  relocate(eigenMT, .before=beta)

# target_pairs: the distinct SNP-gene pairs to compute residuals for.
target_pairs <- all_sig_eqtls_full_df %>%
  distinct(grch37, gene)

# Define visits (excluding visit_5) and groups
visits_to_use <- c("visit_1", "visit_2", "visit_3", "visit_4", "visit_6", "visit_7", "visit_8", "visit_9", "visit_10")
groups <- c("case", "control")

# Initialize a list to store residual results for each SNP-gene pair
residuals_for_all_eqtls <- list()

# Loop over each SNP-gene pair
for (i in seq_len(nrow(target_pairs))) {
  target_snp <- target_pairs$grch37[i]   # SNP identifier
  target_gene <- target_pairs$gene[i] # Gene name
  pair_id <- paste0(target_snp, "_", target_gene)

  # Initialize a data frame to collect residuals for this pair
  residuals_df <- data.frame()

  # Loop over each visit and group
  for (visit in visits_to_use) {
    for (gr in groups) {

      # Skip visit_5 control only
      if(visit == "visit_5" && grp == "control") {
        message("Skipping ", visit, " ", gr)
        next
      }
      # Construct file paths based on our naming convention:
      # Gene expression file (GE), Covariates file, and SNP file.
      ge_file <- file.path(final_dir, visit, gr, paste0(visit, "_", gr, "_GE.txt"))
      covar_file <- file.path(final_dir, visit, gr, paste0(visit, "_", gr, "_Covariates.txt"))
      snp_file <- file.path(final_dir, visit, gr, paste0(visit, "_", gr, "_SNP.txt"))

      # Check that files exist; if not, skip.
      if(!file.exists(ge_file) | !file.exists(covar_file) | !file.exists(snp_file)) {
        message("Missing file(s) for ", visit, " ", gr, ". Skipping this combination.")
        next
      }

      # Read the files
      ge <- fread(ge_file) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "ID")
      covar <- fread(covar_file) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "ID")
      snp <- fread(snp_file) %>% column_to_rownames(var = "ID")

      # Extract expression for target gene
      if(!(target_gene %in% rownames(ge))) {
        message("Target gene ", target_gene, " not found in GE file for ", visit, " ", gr, ".")
        next
      }
      expr_vals <- t(ge[target_gene,]) %>%
                    as.data.frame() %>%
                    setNames("expression") %>%
                    rownames_to_column(var = "core_specific_ids")

      # Extract genotype for target SNP
      if(!(target_snp %in% rownames(snp))) {
        message("Target SNP ", target_snp, " not found in SNP file for ", visit, " ", gr, ".")
        next
      }
      geno_vals <- t(snp[target_snp,]) %>%
                    as.data.frame() %>%
                    setNames("genotype") %>%
                    rownames_to_column(var = "core_specific_ids")

      covar_final <- t(covar) %>%
                    as.data.frame() %>%
                    rownames_to_column(var = "core_specific_ids")

      # Combine into a data frame for regression by core_specific_ids. Covariates has multiple columns.
      dat <- inner_join(expr_vals, geno_vals, by = "core_specific_ids") %>%
            inner_join(covar_final, by = "core_specific_ids") %>%
            column_to_rownames(var = "core_specific_ids")

      # Build the linear model formula: expression ~ (all covariate columns) [DO NOT INCLUDE GENOTYPE]
      covar_names <- colnames(covar_final)[-1]

      formula_str <- paste("expression ~ ", paste(covar_names, collapse = " + "))

      # Fit the linear model
      model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = dat)

      # Extract residuals
      resids <- residuals(model) %>%
            as.data.frame() %>%
            setNames("residuals") %>%
            rownames_to_column(var = "core_specific_ids")

      geno_for_plotting <- dat %>%
                           select(genotype) %>%
                           rownames_to_column(var = "core_specific_ids")

      # Create a data frame with the results for this visit & group
      res_df <- resids %>%
            inner_join(geno_for_plotting, by = "core_specific_ids") %>%
            mutate(visit = visit,
                   group = gr)

      # Append the results to residuals_df
      residuals_df <- bind_rows(residuals_df, res_df)
    }
  }

  # Store the residuals data frame for this SNP-gene pair in the output list
  residuals_for_all_eqtls[[pair_id]] <- residuals_df
}

# Combine all residuals into one large data frame for plotting, adding an identifier column.
combined_residuals <- bind_rows(residuals_for_all_eqtls, .id = "snp_gene_pair") %>%
                      separate(snp_gene_pair, into = c("grch37", "gene"), sep = "_", remove = TRUE)

# Combined residuals dimensions: 336042 7
qs_save(combined_residuals, file.path(residuals_dir, "combined_residuals.qs2"))
```

## Save the significant-eQTL summary statistics joined to residuals

We join the residuals to the significant-eQTL summary statistics to produce the
master plotting and downstream-analysis data frame. This object is read by the
colocalization notebook (`05`) and both figure notebooks (`07`, `08`).

```{r}
# residuals df
combined_residuals <- qs_read(file.path(residuals_dir, "combined_residuals.qs2"))

# final longitudinal plotting df (all info)
all_sig_eqtl_residuals_full <- combined_residuals %>%
                        inner_join(all_sig_eqtls_full_df, by =c("grch37", "gene", "visit", "group"))

# This is the df for all interesting eQTLs from now on.
qs_save(all_sig_eqtl_residuals_full, file = file.path(sumstats_dir, "signif_eqtls_final_tg.qs2"))
```
